cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This sunset photo would make our anniversary card. Look at the balance; you're finally seeing what I meant in those composition lessons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's holding your hand at the edge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still getting caught on the edges. Try this beach one; more room for the message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same person, same bracelet. Who is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good color memory. That bracelet's exactly your color. I used to have to choose these things for you; shall we find you one together?

reason: Use the exact Stance as a method of pursuing this Drive rather than a prefixed reminder. Repair missing interaction details or stalled progression explicitly; preserve distinct alternatives and spoken partner contributions.
